environment.description: Celery worker running on ECS Fargate with task role 'NotificationWorkerRole-Restricted'. The IAM policy uses dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition to scope access, and a separate inline policy with an explicit Deny on dynamodb:Attributes condition key set that prevents reading or writing the 'template' field unless the request also includes a validated 'template_hash' attribute matching a pre-computed HMAC stored in a separate control table. Additionally, the DynamoDB table has a DynamoDB Streams trigger connected to a Lambda validator that retroactively deletes any item where the 'template' field contains format specifiers matching the regex pattern `\{[^}]*\.[^}]*\}` (attribute access patterns). The Lambda runs with a 50ms batch window ensuring near-synchronous enforcement before the Celery worker polls.

dynamodb_streams_lambda.action: Deletes items where template contains attribute-access format patterns

config.network: Private VPC subnet, security group restricts egress to DynamoDB VPC endpoint only
